input.free_text_description: The system operates in the authentication, e-commerce domain. It serves Customer, User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include book, book impl, book store. Core business data revolves around BookStoreWithBooks, PaginatedResult. The system enforces access control and identity verification for protected operations.

user_stories.story: As a Customer, I want to manage user accounts and profiles, so that user information stays current and accurate.
As a Customer, I want to manage book operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a Customer, I want to interact with book impl functionality, so that the system fulfills my needs.
As a Customer, I want to interact with book store functionality, so that the system fulfills my needs.
